text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This battle is nearing its conclusion—
here 
I come.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I draw a highly rated medicated cream
from 
the web! And set it with same-day 
delivery!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With this, I counter the pimple's 
inflammation. Turn end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite Rulership's best efforts, the 
ordered product failed to resolve her
skin 
troubles.
